item.title: Potter County weighs $200M jail as overcrowding costs taxpayers $1M a year
item.description: Nearly a year after the Potter County Jail failed a state inspection due to overcrowding, county leaders are debating how address a growing inmate population, a problem that has already cost taxpayers about $1 million over the past year and could lead to a jail project exceeding $200 million.
